reading: `+1` describes a success with ZERO step cost, which no episode can reach: the largest reachable undiscounted return is 0.9800. `-1` likewise describes a failure with zero step cost, whereas the worst reachable return is -1.1800. A38 already removed exactly this hard-coded +-1 from the kernel's return_value; `08`'s targets appear to predate that correction and were never rescaled.
downstream_hazard: 8.3% of the canonical support's D slots are tied-optimal (A75 pre-check). A NegativeOnly-style write of a failure value into the FACTUAL entry therefore corrupts an entry that was already optimal on those slots.
note: audit only; no formula is proposed here, and no code is changed
